description: 彼特罗夫防御 C42 — 关键时机：d6先于Nxe4的精确顺序

intro.popup_en:
Key Timing, Demo 1
The Petrov Defense: Black does not defend e5 directly, but counterattacks e4. When is it safe to recapture the pawn, and why is the move order critical?
intro.popup:
关键时机演示1

彼特罗夫防御！

黑方不防守e5，
而是反击e4！

核心问题：
什么时候吃回兵？
顺序为何至关重要？

outro.popup_en: The move order is essential: first play ...d6 to drive away the knight; only then capture with ...Nxe4. If Black plays ...Nxe4 immediately, Qe2 wins a piece. One tempo changes everything.
outro.popup:
彼特罗夫时机总结

精确顺序是关键：
① 先3...d6驱马（不能省！）
② 再4...Nxe4安全吃回
③ 若3...Nxe4?? 则Qe2立刻输子

一步之差，结果天壤之别！

moves.popup:
Nf6！反击e4
不防守，而是进攻
moves.popup_en: ...Nf6! Black counterattacks e4 rather than defending e5.

moves.popup:
d6！关键时机！
先驱走白马，不能直接Nxe4
moves.popup_en: ...d6! The key move-order detail: drive away the knight first; do not capture on e4 yet.
Nf3 retreats as the knight is forced away.

moves.popup:
Nxe4！现在安全吃回
完全对等！
moves.popup_en: ...Nxe4! Now Black can safely recover the pawn, reaching an equal position.
c4 breaks the symmetry and challenges the center.
c4 gains space and challenges the queen.

moves.popup:
d5！白方中心推进
时机成熟
moves.popup_en: d5! White advances in the center when the timing is right.
